records.mechanism: Pendulum hypnosis learned from the street hypnotist Tosim

records.title: Inayah
records.meta: Sinetron · Indosiar 2009 (rerun ANTV 2020) · Soraya Intercine Films · Indonesia
records.mechanism: Hypnosis by Pak Sentot, hired by Teddy
records.summary: In the harem drama about Raden Doso's wives, Teddy has the hypnotist Pak Sentot hypnotise Ajeng: when she is woken she falls unconscious again under hypnosis. In the next episode she escapes and Sentot is blamed for failing.

records.title: Pelet
records.meta: Film · Indonesia · Indonesian · dir. Imam Tantowi
records.mechanism: Pelet love magic through a dukun
records.summary: At Saraswati's wedding to Pandu, Sam, whom she had rejected, appears. Pandu has an accident, and with a dukun's help Sam 'tames' Saraswati with pelet. Sam's jealous girlfriend Utari uses another dukun to disfigure Saraswati, who is cured by a kyai; Sam is killed by Utari's gang.
records.kids_note: Newly married at the start; no children mentioned.
records.provenance: Indonesian sinetron/FTV deep pass, 15 Oct 2026 PT (adults only)
records.note: loose fit: pelet love magic rather than hypnosis.

records.summary: When Yasmin panics because Diah has been kidnapped, Romeo, a doctor trained in hypnosis, has her close her eyes, calms her and brings her round, and she is at peace again.
